summary.zh-CN: 深度可分离[[term:convolution|卷积]]把[[term:standard-convolution|标准卷积]]拆成两步：[[term:depthwise-convolution|深度卷积]]先让每个输入通道各自用一个卷积核单独提取空间信息，通道之间互不混合；随后[[term:pointwise-convolution|逐点卷积]]用 1×1 卷积把不同通道的信息重新组合。
summary.en-US: Depthwise separable [[term:convolution|convolution]] splits [[term:standard-convolution|standard convolution]] into two steps: [[term:depthwise-convolution|depthwise convolution]] first extracts spatial information independently with one kernel per input channel, without mixing channels; [[term:pointwise-convolution|pointwise convolution]] then uses a 1×1 convolution to recombine information across channels.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 先逐通道处理空间，再用 1×1 卷积混合通道，可以显著减少参数量和计算量。
coreConclusion.en-US: Process spatial neighborhoods channel by channel, then mix channels with a 1×1 convolution to significantly reduce parameter count and computation.
